title: market.review.rated v1
description: Consumed by CORE when MARKET collects a rating about a CORE identity or organization. Carries the rating only: the review text, title and any other content stay in MARKET, which owns them and is the only system that can moderate, redact or delete them. review_reference is MARKET's own identifier for the review and is the exactly-once key CORE records the signal under, so a redelivery is refused without CORE knowing what was written.

review_reference.description: MARKET's identifier for the review. Opaque to CORE; unique per producer within a tenant.

organization_id.description: The CORE tenant the signal belongs to.

subject_type.description: The kind of CORE entity being rated. A rating about a MARKET or MOVE entity has no subject in CORE and is refused.

subject_id.description: The rated CORE identity or organization.

rating.description: The reported rating. Bounds are part of the contract, so an out-of-range value is refused at the boundary rather than stored and averaged.

rated_at.description: When MARKET recorded the rating. A producer claim; CORE stamps its own recorded_at and orders by that.
